questions.stem: Why do simple covalent substances have low boiling points?

options.text: The atoms inside the molecules break apart easily
The intermolecular forces between molecules are weak and require little energy to overcome
The molecules are very heavy and sink to the bottom
The covalent bonds within molecules are weak

questions.explanation: Simple covalent substances have low boiling points because the intermolecular forces between molecules are weak and require little energy to overcome. The covalent bonds within the molecules are strong and do NOT break during boiling - only the weak forces between molecules are overcome.
